summary: Very steep residential street, 16.7% mean grade, dwelling 11 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Homes with pools line both sides; one dwelling is 11 m from the kerb and the rest are within about 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street with a few parked cars; no pull-off or verge, and the slope is too steep to park a van safely.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street under a powerline.
drivers.convention: Cars are parked on the lower part and nothing is signed here.

flags: Steep: mean 16.7%, max 28.4% grade, over the 12% limit
Brisbane River 187 m away, elevation 19 to 26 m
sun_shade: Open sky over the road; garden trees shade the west side.
